question: How should the wandering mind be brought back to calm?
premises: it is restrained and led to calm
otherwise it clings to objects again
inference: repeated self-return prevents the mind from falling back into objects
uncertainties: fused sandhi forms retained as given
plain_english: Wherever the unsteady mind goes out, restrain it and lead it to calm in the self; otherwise the unstable mind again clings to objects.
